---
title: "STARR-seq Control regions included"
output: html_document
date: "2024-10-31"
---

Early analysis did not include the one positive and five negative regions. This is the updated analysis.

By checking the bam files in IGV, there was no sequencing reads at all for the only positive region included. Below is James' reply:
I had a feeling that this might happen, after finishing the experiments and prepping the sequencing library it donned on me that the ISE (ISL1 enhancer) I used was 1.5 kb. This was used because it was previously cloned into the STARR seq vector and tested (with positive expression by qPCR when transfected alone) by previous lab members and to my knowledge a shorter 500 bp ISE was not generated or tested. Given the ISE sequence wasn't even detected in the input sample and the length was much longer my guess would be that the ISE fragment was not efficiently amplified and/or lost in the purification/library prep (size selection steps) as these are geared towards 500 bp fragments. I'm glad to see the negative controls worked!

So the analysis next only included the 5 negative regions along with the target regions.

Calculate the coverage for each target region.
```{bash}
cd /gau/isilon/int/xzhang/Pacemaker/STARR_seq/BWA/bedtools/
for file in Filter_*_pc_per_base.txt
do
awk '{print $1"\t"$2"\t"$2"\t"$3}' $file | 
/gau/isilon/int/xzhang/software/bedtools intersect -a stdin -b /gau/isilon/int/xzhang/Pacemaker/STARR_seq/Control_Regions_Included/STARR_Target_Regions_Controls_Regions_Included.bed -wa -wb > /gau/isilon/int/xzhang/Pacemaker/STARR_seq/Control_Regions_Included/Target_$file
done
```

Note that there are two overlapping target regions:
chr7	100879691	100880191
chr7	100879727	100880227
To count the number of off-target and on-target coverage, generate separate bed for this purpose so the overlapping regions won't be double counted.
```{bash}
cd /gau/isilon/int/xzhang/Pacemaker/STARR_seq/BWA/bedtools/
for file in Filter_*_pc_per_base.txt
do
awk '{print $1"\t"$2"\t"$2"\t"$3}' $file | 
/gau/isilon/int/xzhang/software/bedtools intersect -a stdin -b /gau/isilon/int/xzhang/Pacemaker/STARR_seq/Control_Regions_Included/STARR_Target_Regions_Controls_Regions_Included.bed -u > /gau/isilon/int/xzhang/Pacemaker/STARR_seq/Control_Regions_Included/Unique_Target_$file
done

cd /gau/isilon/int/xzhang/Pacemaker/STARR_seq/Control_Regions_Included/
for file in Unique_Target*_pc_per_base.txt
do
echo $file
awk '{sum += $4} END {print sum}' ${file}
done
rm Unique*

### Count all the bps.
cd /gau/isilon/int/xzhang/Pacemaker/STARR_seq/BWA/bedtools
for file in Filter*_pc_per_base.txt
do
echo $file
awk '{sum += $3} END {print sum}' ${file}
done
```

This is to double check the input on-target bases vs. all bases.
```{r}
target_input <- read.table("/gau/isilon/int/xzhang/Pacemaker/STARR_seq/BWA/bedtools/Filter_sorted_JE_input_aln-pe.bam_pc_per_base.txt", sep = "\t")
target_input <- mutate(target_input, Pos = paste0(V1,":", V2))

tmp <- read.table("/gau/isilon/int/xzhang/Pacemaker/STARR_seq/Control_Regions_Included/Target_Filter_sorted_JE_input_aln-pe.bam_pc_per_base.txt", sep = "\t")
tmp <- mutate(tmp, Pos = paste0(V1,":", V2))

length(intersect(tmp$Pos, target_input$Pos))
length(setdiff(target_input$Pos, tmp$Pos))

tmp$Pos[!tmp$Pos %in% target_input$Pos]
```

Sum up the reads for each target region and normalize the read depth.
```{r}
library(dplyr)
## Read in target regions.
target <- read.table("/gau/isilon/int/xzhang/Pacemaker/STARR_seq/Control_Regions_Included/STARR_Target_Regions_Controls_Regions_Included.bed", sep = "\t", header = F)
target <- select(target, 1:3)
target <- mutate(target, Fragment = paste0(V1,":",V2,"_",V3))


## Replicate JE_input
JE_input <- read.table("/gau/isilon/int/xzhang/Pacemaker/STARR_seq/Control_Regions_Included/Target_Filter_sorted_JE_input_aln-pe.bam_pc_per_base.txt", sep = "\t", header = F)
JE_input <- mutate(JE_input, Fragment = paste0(V5,":",V6,"_",V7))
length(unique(JE_input$Fragment))
JE_input <- JE_input %>% 
  group_by(Fragment) %>% 
  summarise(Depth = sum(V4))
JE_input <- mutate(JE_input, CPM = Depth * 1e6 / sum(JE_input$Depth) )
JE_input <- left_join(target, JE_input, by = "Fragment")
JE_input$Depth[is.na(JE_input$Depth)] = 0
JE_input$CPM[is.na(JE_input$CPM)] = 0

## Replicate JE211101
JE211101 <- read.table("/gau/isilon/int/xzhang/Pacemaker/STARR_seq/Control_Regions_Included/Target_Filter_sorted_JE211101_aln-pe.bam_pc_per_base.txt", sep = "\t", header = F)
JE211101 <- mutate(JE211101, Fragment = paste0(V5,":",V6,"_",V7))
length(unique(JE211101$Fragment))

  group_by(Fragment) %>% 
  summarise(Depth = sum(V4))
JE211101 <- mutate(JE211101, CPM = Depth * 1e6 / sum(JE211101$Depth) )
JE211101 <- left_join(target, JE211101, by = "Fragment")
JE211101$Depth[is.na(JE211101$Depth)] = 0
JE211101$CPM[is.na(JE211101$CPM)] = 0

## Replicate JE211121
JE211121 <- read.table("/gau/isilon/int/xzhang/Pacemaker/STARR_seq/Control_Regions_Included/Target_Filter_sorted_JE211121_aln-pe.bam_pc_per_base.txt", sep = "\t", header = F)

JE211121 <- mutate(JE211121, CPM = Depth * 1e6 / sum(JE211121$Depth) )
JE211121 <- left_join(target, JE211121, by = "Fragment")
JE211121$Depth[is.na(JE211121$Depth)] = 0
JE211121$CPM[is.na(JE211121$CPM)] = 0

## Replicate JE240314
JE240314 <- read.table("/gau/isilon/int/xzhang/Pacemaker/STARR_seq/Control_Regions_Included/Target_Filter_sorted_JE240314_aln-pe.bam_pc_per_base.txt", sep = "\t", header = F)
```

Calculate the log2 of each replicate vs input for each target region after adding pseudocount 1.
```{r}
table(JE211101$Fragment==JE_input$Fragment)
names(JE211101) <- c("Chr", "Start", "End", "Fragment", "Depth_JE211101", "CPM_JE211101")
JE211101 <- mutate(JE211101, Log2FC_JE211101 = log2((JE211101$CPM_JE211101+1)/(JE_input$CPM+1)))

table(JE211121$Fragment==JE_input$Fragment)
names(JE211121) <- c("Chr", "Start", "End", "Fragment", "Depth_JE211121", "CPM_JE211121")
JE211121 <- mutate(JE211121, Log2FC_JE211121 = log2((JE211121$CPM_JE211121+1)/(JE_input$CPM+1)))

table(JE240314$Fragment==JE_input$Fragment)
names(JE240314) <- c("Chr", "Start", "End", "Fragment", "Depth_JE240314", "CPM_JE240314")
JE240314 <- mutate(JE240314, Log2FC_JE240314 = log2((JE240314$CPM_JE240314+1)/(JE_input$CPM+1)))

table(JE240325$Fragment==JE_input$Fragment)
names(JE240325) <- c("Chr", "Start", "End", "Fragment", "Depth_JE240325", "CPM_JE240325")
JE240325 <- mutate(JE240325, Log2FC_JE240325 = log2((JE240325$CPM_JE240325+1)/(JE_input$CPM+1)))

table(JE240404$Fragment==JE_input$Fragment)
names(JE240404) <- c("Chr", "Start", "End", "Fragment", "Depth_JE240404", "CPM_JE240404")
JE240404 <- mutate(JE240404, Log2FC_JE240404 = log2((JE240404$CPM_JE240404+1)/(JE_input$CPM+1)))

names(JE_input) <- c("Chr", "Start", "End", "Fragment", "Depth_Input", "CPM_Input")
results <- cbind(JE_input, JE211101[,5:7], JE211121[,5:7], JE240314[,5:7], JE240325[,5:7], JE240404[,5:7])

results$Rank_JE211101 <- rank(-results$Log2FC_JE211101)
results$Rank_JE211121 <- rank(-results$Log2FC_JE211121)
results$Rank_JE240314 <- rank(-results$Log2FC_JE240314)
results$Rank_JE240325 <- rank(-results$Log2FC_JE240325)
results$Rank_JE240404 <- rank(-results$Log2FC_JE240404)

results <- mutate(results, Ave_Log2FC = (Log2FC_JE211101+Log2FC_JE211121+Log2FC_JE240314+Log2FC_JE240325+Log2FC_JE240404)/5, Ave_Rank = (Rank_JE211101+Rank_JE211121+Rank_JE240314+Rank_JE240325+Rank_JE240404)/5)

write.table(distinct(results), "/gau/isilon/int/xzhang/Pacemaker/STARR_seq/Control_Regions_Included/Log2FC.txt", sep = "\t", quote = F, row.names = F)
```


Generates a coverage track (bigWig or bedGraph) using deepTools' bamCoverage to cross-check the results.
```{bash}
cd /home/xzhang08
source ~/miniconda3/bin/activate
conda activate deepTools
cd /gau/isilon/int/xzhang/Pacemaker/STARR_seq/BWA

## index the bam first
for file in Filter*bam
do
/gau/isilon/int/xzhang/software/samtools-1.20/samtools index $file
done

### Test which options are the best using one sample.
bamCoverage --bam Filter_sorted_JE211101_aln-pe.bam -o deepTools/Filter_sorted_JE211101_aln-pe_bamCoverage.bw \
    --binSize 1 \
    --normalizeUsing CPM \
    --extendReads
    
bamCoverage --bam Filter_sorted_JE211101_aln-pe.bam -o deepTools/Filter_sorted_JE211101_aln-pe_bamCoverage_no_extension.bw \
```

Convert bcf to vcf and extract the counts for each allele of the SNPs.
```{bash}
cd /gau/isilon/int/xzhang/Pacemaker/STARR_seq/BWA/bcftools
for file in *bcf
do
/gau/isilon/int/xzhang/software/bcftools-1.21/bin/bcftools view ${file} -O v -o ${file}.vcf
done

for file in *vcf
do
/gau/isilon/int/xzhang/software/bcftools-1.21/bin/bcftools query -f '%CHROM\t%POS\t%REF\t%ALT\t [%AD]\n' $file | awk '{gsub(/,/, "\t"); print}' > Allele_Count_${file}
done
```

Perform Fisher's exact test for each SNP.
```{r}
### Read in the allele count for each sample.
snp_JE_input <- read.table("/gau/isilon/int/xzhang/Pacemaker/STARR_seq/BWA/bcftools/Allele_Count_JE_input.bcf.vcf", header = F, sep = "\t")
snp_JE_input <- mutate(snp_JE_input, Pos = paste0(V1, ":", V2))
names(snp_JE_input)[1:6] <- paste0("JE_input_", c("chr", "Coordinate", "Ref", "Alt", "Ref_Count", "Alt_Count"))

snp_JE211101 <- read.table("/gau/isilon/int/xzhang/Pacemaker/STARR_seq/BWA/bcftools/Allele_Count_JE211101.bcf.vcf", header = F, sep = "\t")
snp_JE211101 <- mutate(snp_JE211101, Pos = paste0(V1, ":", V2))
names(snp_JE211101)[1:6] <- paste0("JE211101_", c("chr", "Coordinate", "Ref", "Alt", "Ref_Count", "Alt_Count"))

snp_JE211121 <- read.table("/gau/isilon/int/xzhang/Pacemaker/STARR_seq/BWA/bcftools/Allele_Count_JE211121.bcf.vcf", header = F, sep = "\t")
snp_JE211121 <- mutate(snp_JE211121, Pos = paste0(V1, ":", V2))
names(snp_JE211121)[1:6] <- paste0("JE211121_", c("chr", "Coordinate", "Ref", "Alt", "Ref_Count", "Alt_Count"))

snp_JE240314 <- read.table("/gau/isilon/int/xzhang/Pacemaker/STARR_seq/BWA/bcftools/Allele_Count_JE240314.bcf.vcf", header = F, sep = "\t")
snp_JE240314 <- mutate(snp_JE240314, Pos = paste0(V1, ":", V2))
names(snp_JE240314)[1:6] <- paste0("JE240314_", c("chr", "Coordinate", "Ref", "Alt", "Ref_Count", "Alt_Count"))

snp_JE240325 <- read.table("/gau/isilon/int/xzhang/Pacemaker/STARR_seq/BWA/bcftools/Allele_Count_JE240325.bcf.vcf", header = F, sep = "\t")
snp_JE240325 <- mutate(snp_JE240325, Pos = paste0(V1, ":", V2))
names(snp_JE240325)[1:6] <- paste0("JE240325_", c("chr", "Coordinate", "Ref", "Alt", "Ref_Count", "Alt_Count"))

snp_JE240404 <- read.table("/gau/isilon/int/xzhang/Pacemaker/STARR_seq/BWA/bcftools/Allele_Count_JE240404.bcf.vcf", header = F, sep = "\t")
snp_JE240404 <- mutate(snp_JE240404, Pos = paste0(V1, ":", V2))
names(snp_JE240404)[1:6] <- paste0("JE240404_", c("chr", "Coordinate", "Ref", "Alt", "Ref_Count", "Alt_Count"))

length(intersect(snp_JE_input$Pos, snp_JE211101$Pos))
length(intersect(snp_JE_input$Pos, snp_JE211121$Pos))
length(intersect(snp_JE_input$Pos, snp_JE240314$Pos))
length(intersect(snp_JE_input$Pos, snp_JE240325$Pos))
length(intersect(snp_JE_input$Pos, snp_JE240404$Pos))

### Obtain the SNPs in all samples.
overlap <- Reduce(intersect, list(snp_JE_input$Pos, snp_JE211101$Pos, snp_JE211121$Pos, snp_JE240314$Pos, snp_JE240325$Pos, snp_JE240404$Pos))

### Create a data frame for results.
snp_res <- data.frame(Pos = overlap)
snp_res <- left_join(snp_res, snp_JE_input, by = "Pos")
snp_res <- left_join(snp_res, snp_JE211101, by = "Pos")
snp_res <- left_join(snp_res, snp_JE211121, by = "Pos")
snp_res <- left_join(snp_res, snp_JE240314, by = "Pos")
snp_res <- left_join(snp_res, snp_JE240325, by = "Pos")
snp_res <- left_join(snp_res, snp_JE240404, by = "Pos")

### Check if the columns are the same across samples.
for(i in c(2,8,14,20,26,32)+3){
  print(table(snp_res[,5]==snp_res[,i]))
}

### Reduce the redundant columns.
snp_res <- select(snp_res, 1:7, 12:13, 18:19, 24:25, 30:31, 36:37)
names(snp_res)[2:5] <- c("Chr", "Coordinate", "Ref", "Alt")
snp_res$pvalue_JE211101 = 1
snp_res$ratio_JE211101 = 1
snp_res$pvalue_JE211121 = 1
snp_res$ratio_JE211121 = 1
snp_res$pvalue_JE240314 = 1
snp_res$ratio_JE240314 = 1
snp_res$pvalue_JE240325 = 1
snp_res$ratio_JE240325 = 1
snp_res$pvalue_JE240404 = 1
snp_res$ratio_JE240404 = 1


for(i in 1:nrow(snp_res)){
  tmp <- c(snp_res$JE211101_Ref_Count[i], snp_res$JE211101_Alt_Count[i], snp_res$JE_input_Ref_Count[i], snp_res$JE_input_Alt_Count[i])
  dim(tmp) <- c(2,2)
  tmp_test <- fisher.test(tmp)
  snp_res$pvalue_JE211101[i] = tmp_test[["p.value"]]
  snp_res$ratio_JE211101[i] = tmp_test[["estimate"]]
}
snp_res$FDR_JE211101 = p.adjust(snp_res$pvalue_JE211101)

for(i in 1:nrow(snp_res)){
  tmp <- c(snp_res$JE211121_Ref_Count[i], snp_res$JE211121_Alt_Count[i], snp_res$JE_input_Ref_Count[i], snp_res$JE_input_Alt_Count[i])
  dim(tmp) <- c(2,2)
  tmp_test <- fisher.test(tmp)
  snp_res$pvalue_JE211121[i] = tmp_test[["p.value"]]
  snp_res$ratio_JE211121[i] = tmp_test[["estimate"]]
}
snp_res$FDR_JE211121 = p.adjust(snp_res$pvalue_JE211121)

for(i in 1:nrow(snp_res)){
  tmp <- c(snp_res$JE240314_Ref_Count[i], snp_res$JE240314_Alt_Count[i], snp_res$JE_input_Ref_Count[i], snp_res$JE_input_Alt_Count[i])
  dim(tmp) <- c(2,2)
  tmp_test <- fisher.test(tmp)
  snp_res$pvalue_JE240314[i] = tmp_test[["p.value"]]
  snp_res$ratio_JE240314[i] = tmp_test[["estimate"]]
}
snp_res$FDR_JE240314 = p.adjust(snp_res$pvalue_JE240314)

for(i in 1:nrow(snp_res)){
  tmp <- c(snp_res$JE240325_Ref_Count[i], snp_res$JE240325_Alt_Count[i], snp_res$JE_input_Ref_Count[i], snp_res$JE_input_Alt_Count[i])
  dim(tmp) <- c(2,2)
  tmp_test <- fisher.test(tmp)
  snp_res$pvalue_JE240325[i] = tmp_test[["p.value"]]
  snp_res$ratio_JE240325[i] = tmp_test[["estimate"]]
}
snp_res$FDR_JE240325 = p.adjust(snp_res$pvalue_JE240325)

for(i in 1:nrow(snp_res)){
  tmp <- c(snp_res$JE240404_Ref_Count[i], snp_res$JE240404_Alt_Count[i], snp_res$JE_input_Ref_Count[i], snp_res$JE_input_Alt_Count[i])
  dim(tmp) <- c(2,2)
  tmp_test <- fisher.test(tmp)
  snp_res$pvalue_JE240404[i] = tmp_test[["p.value"]]
  snp_res$ratio_JE240404[i] = tmp_test[["estimate"]]
}
snp_res$FDR_JE240404 = p.adjust(snp_res$pvalue_JE240404)

### Perform the test by combining the counts for all replicates.
snp_res <- mutate(snp_res, combine_Ref_Count = JE211101_Ref_Count + JE211121_Ref_Count + JE240314_Ref_Count + JE240325_Ref_Count + JE240404_Ref_Count, combine_Alt_Count = JE211101_Alt_Count + JE211121_Alt_Count + JE240314_Alt_Count + JE240325_Alt_Count + JE240404_Alt_Count)
snp_res$pvalue_combine = 1
snp_res$ratio_combine = 1
for(i in 1:nrow(snp_res)){
  tmp <- c(snp_res$combine_Ref_Count[i], snp_res$combine_Alt_Count[i], snp_res$JE_input_Ref_Count[i], snp_res$JE_input_Alt_Count[i])
  dim(tmp) <- c(2,2)
  tmp_test <- fisher.test(tmp)
  snp_res$pvalue_combine[i] = tmp_test[["p.value"]]
  snp_res$ratio_combine[i] = tmp_test[["estimate"]]
}
snp_res$FDR_combine = p.adjust(snp_res$pvalue_combine)

### Output results
write_xlsx(snp_res, "/gau/isilon/int/xzhang/Pacemaker/STARR_seq/Control_Regions_Included/Fisher_test_SNPs.xlsx")
```

Focus on the fragments with log2FC > 0.585 (FC > 1.5)
```{r}
## Calculate the proportion of the ref allele.
snp_res_fragment <- mutate(snp_res_fragment, JE_input_Ref_per = JE_input_Ref_Count/(JE_input_Ref_Count+JE_input_Alt_Count), JE211101_Ref_per = JE211101_Ref_Count/(JE211101_Ref_Count+JE211101_Alt_Count), JE211121_Ref_per = JE211121_Ref_Count/(JE211121_Ref_Count+JE211121_Alt_Count), JE240314_Ref_per = JE240314_Ref_Count/(JE240314_Ref_Count+JE240314_Alt_Count), JE240325_Ref_per = JE240325_Ref_Count/(JE240325_Ref_Count+JE240325_Alt_Count), JE240404_Ref_per = JE240404_Ref_Count/(JE240404_Ref_Count+JE240404_Alt_Count))

snp_res_fragment_sig <- filter(snp_res_fragment, Ave_Log2FC > log2(1.5))

snp_res_fragment_sig <- arrange(snp_res_fragment_sig, JE_input_Ref_per)
snp_res_fragment_sig$Order <- 1:nrow(snp_res_fragment_sig)

write_xlsx(snp_res_fragment_sig, "/gau/isilon/int/xzhang/Pacemaker/STARR_seq/Control_Regions_Included/Fisher_test_SNPs_with_FC_Sig.xlsx")
```

```{r}
ggarrange(JE_input_snp_plot + rremove("x.text"), JE211101_snp_plot + rremove("x.text"), JE211121_snp_plot + rremove("x.text"), JE240314_snp_plot + rremove("x.text"), JE240325_snp_plot + rremove("x.text"), JE240404_snp_plot,  
          labels = c("JE_input", "JE211101", "JE211121", "JE240314", "JE240325", "JE240404"),
          ncol = 1, nrow = 6, heights = c(1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1))
ggsave("/gau/isilon/int/xzhang/Pacemaker/STARR_seq/Control_Regions_Included/SNP_Ref_Per_FC1.5_Track_1.pdf", height = 10, width = 20)
```

Try another way to test the differential activity between two alleles of the same SNP:
1) Normalize the read depth for two alleles separately for the same SNPs in the same sample.
2) Calculate the log2FC of each allele between replicates vs input separately.
3) Perform wilcox test for the log2FC between the two alleles for the same SNPs.

Try normalizing using the total coverage across the target regions.
```{r}
wilcox_data <- select(snp_res_fragment, 1:17, 43, 51, 54, 57, 60, 63, 69)
wilcox_data <- filter(wilcox_data, Ave_Log2FC > log2(1.5))

## Normalize the read depth.
wilcox_data <- mutate(wilcox_data, 
                    JE_input_Ref_depth = (JE_input_Ref_Count+1)/5507508027, JE_input_Alt_depth = (JE_input_Alt_Count+1)/5507508027, 
                    JE211101_Ref_depth = (JE211101_Ref_Count+1)/4740188545, JE211101_Alt_depth = (JE211101_Alt_Count+1)/4740188545, 
                    JE211121_Ref_depth = (JE211121_Ref_Count+1)/5956659074, JE211121_Alt_depth = (JE211121_Alt_Count+1)/5956659074, 
                    JE240314_Ref_depth = (JE240314_Ref_Count+1)/6404059844, JE240314_Alt_depth = (JE240314_Alt_Count+1)/6404059844, 
                    JE240325_Ref_depth = (JE240325_Ref_Count+1)/5738210845, JE240325_Alt_depth = (JE240325_Alt_Count+1)/5738210845, 
                    JE240404_Ref_depth = (JE240404_Ref_Count+1)/7254690869, JE240404_Alt_depth = (JE240404_Alt_Count+1)/7254690869)

wilcox_data <- mutate(wilcox_data, 
                      JE211101_Ref_LogFC = log2(JE211101_Ref_depth/JE_input_Ref_depth), 
                      JE211101_Alt_LogFC = log2(JE211101_Alt_depth/JE_input_Alt_depth), 
                      JE211121_Ref_LogFC = log2(JE211121_Ref_depth/JE_input_Ref_depth), 
                      JE211121_Alt_LogFC = log2(JE211121_Alt_depth/JE_input_Alt_depth),                       
                      JE240314_Ref_LogFC = log2(JE240314_Ref_depth/JE_input_Ref_depth), 
                      JE240314_Alt_LogFC = log2(JE240314_Alt_depth/JE_input_Alt_depth),  
                      JE240325_Ref_LogFC = log2(JE240325_Ref_depth/JE_input_Ref_depth), 
                      JE240325_Alt_LogFC = log2(JE240325_Alt_depth/JE_input_Alt_depth), 
                      JE240404_Ref_LogFC = log2(JE240404_Ref_depth/JE_input_Ref_depth), 
                      JE240404_Alt_LogFC = log2(JE240404_Alt_depth/JE_input_Alt_depth))


for(i in 1:nrow(wilcox_data)){
  ref <- c(wilcox_data$JE211101_Ref_LogFC[i], wilcox_data$JE211121_Ref_LogFC[i], wilcox_data$JE240314_Ref_LogFC[i], wilcox_data$JE240325_Ref_LogFC[i], wilcox_data$JE240404_Ref_LogFC[i])
  alt <- c(wilcox_data$JE211101_Alt_LogFC[i], wilcox_data$JE211121_Alt_LogFC[i], wilcox_data$JE240314_Alt_LogFC[i], wilcox_data$JE240325_Alt_LogFC[i], wilcox_data$JE240404_Alt_LogFC[i])
  tmp_test <- t.test(ref, alt, paired = TRUE)
  wilcox_data$pvalue[i] = tmp_test[["p.value"]]
  wilcox_data$diff[i] = tmp_test[["estimate"]]
  wilcox_data$Ref_LogFC_Ave[i] = mean(ref)
  wilcox_data$Alt_LogFC_Ave[i] = mean(alt)
}
wilcox_data$FDR = p.adjust(wilcox_data$pvalue)
table(wilcox_data$FDR<0.05)

write_xlsx(wilcox_data, "/gau/isilon/int/xzhang/Pacemaker/STARR_seq/Control_Regions_Included/T_test_alleles_Norm_By_CPM.xlsx")

wilcox_data_info <- left_join(wilcox_data, info, by = "Fragment")
write_xlsx(wilcox_data_info, "/gau/isilon/int/xzhang/Pacemaker/STARR_seq/Control_Regions_Included/T_test_alleles_Norm_By_CPM_Info.xlsx")

wilcox_data_plot <- select(wilcox_data, 1, 37:46)
#### draw scatter plot.
library(tidyverse)
library(ggsignif)
library(ggforce)
library(paletteer)
pdf("/gau/isilon/int/xzhang/Pacemaker/STARR_seq/Control_Regions_Included/T_test_alleles_Norm_By_CPM.pdf", width = 2, height = 3)
for(i in 1:nrow(wilcox_data_plot)){
  tmp = as.data.frame(t(wilcox_data_plot[i,]))
  names(tmp) <- "value"
  tmp = data.frame(Col= rownames(tmp), Value = tmp$value)
  tmp = tmp[-1,]
  tmp <- separate(tmp, Col, into = c("Sample", "Allele", "LogFC"), sep = "_")
  tmp <- select(tmp, 1, 2, 4)
  tmp$Value=as.numeric(tmp$Value)
  p <- ggplot(tmp, aes(Allele, Value, group = Sample)) + geom_line(colour = "black", position=position_dodge2(width = 0.2)) + geom_point(aes(fill = Allele), shape = 21, size = 5, show.legend = FALSE, position=position_dodge2(width = 0.2), stroke = 0.8, alpha = 0.9) + scale_fill_manual(values = paletteer_d("ggpomological::pomological_palette")) + labs(y="Log2FC") + ggtitle(wilcox_data_plot[i,1]) + theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 10, colour = "black"))
  print(p)
}
dev.off()
```

Try normalizing using only the reads covering the SNPs, but this appears to be the right way as some of the log2FC values are negative for the top enhancers. So should use the CPM normalization.
```{r}
wilcox_data <- select(snp_res_fragment, 1:17, 43, 51, 54, 57, 60, 63, 69)
wilcox_data <- filter(wilcox_data, Ave_Log2FC > log2(1.5))

## Normalize the read depth.
wilcox_data <- mutate(wilcox_data, 
JE_input_Ref_depth = (JE_input_Ref_Count+1)/sum(c(wilcox_data$JE_input_Ref_Count, wilcox_data$JE_input_Alt_Count)),
JE_input_Alt_depth = (JE_input_Alt_Count+1)/sum(c(wilcox_data$JE_input_Ref_Count, wilcox_data$JE_input_Alt_Count)),

JE211101_Ref_depth = (JE211101_Ref_Count+1)/sum(c(wilcox_data$JE211101_Ref_Count, wilcox_data$JE211101_Alt_Count)),
JE211101_Alt_depth = (JE211101_Alt_Count+1)/sum(c(wilcox_data$JE211101_Ref_Count, wilcox_data$JE211101_Alt_Count)),

JE211121_Ref_depth = (JE211121_Ref_Count+1)/sum(c(wilcox_data$JE211121_Ref_Count, wilcox_data$JE211121_Alt_Count)),
JE211121_Alt_depth = (JE211121_Alt_Count+1)/sum(c(wilcox_data$JE211121_Ref_Count, wilcox_data$JE211121_Alt_Count)),

JE240314_Ref_depth = (JE240314_Ref_Count+1)/sum(c(wilcox_data$JE240314_Ref_Count, wilcox_data$JE240314_Alt_Count)),
JE240314_Alt_depth = (JE240314_Alt_Count+1)/sum(c(wilcox_data$JE240314_Ref_Count, wilcox_data$JE240314_Alt_Count)),

JE240325_Ref_depth = (JE240325_Ref_Count+1)/sum(c(wilcox_data$JE240325_Ref_Count, wilcox_data$JE240325_Alt_Count)),
JE240325_Alt_depth = (JE240325_Alt_Count+1)/sum(c(wilcox_data$JE240325_Ref_Count, wilcox_data$JE240325_Alt_Count)),

JE240404_Ref_depth = (JE240404_Ref_Count+1)/sum(c(wilcox_data$JE240404_Ref_Count, wilcox_data$JE240404_Alt_Count)),
JE240404_Alt_depth = (JE240404_Alt_Count+1)/sum(c(wilcox_data$JE240404_Ref_Count, wilcox_data$JE240404_Alt_Count)))

wilcox_data <- mutate(wilcox_data, 
                      JE211101_Ref_LogFC = log2(JE211101_Ref_depth/JE_input_Ref_depth), 
                      JE211101_Alt_LogFC = log2(JE211101_Alt_depth/JE_input_Alt_depth), 
                      JE211121_Ref_LogFC = log2(JE211121_Ref_depth/JE_input_Ref_depth), 
                      JE211121_Alt_LogFC = log2(JE211121_Alt_depth/JE_input_Alt_depth),                       
                      JE240314_Ref_LogFC = log2(JE240314_Ref_depth/JE_input_Ref_depth), 
                      JE240314_Alt_LogFC = log2(JE240314_Alt_depth/JE_input_Alt_depth),  
                      JE240325_Ref_LogFC = log2(JE240325_Ref_depth/JE_input_Ref_depth), 
                      JE240325_Alt_LogFC = log2(JE240325_Alt_depth/JE_input_Alt_depth), 
                      JE240404_Ref_LogFC = log2(JE240404_Ref_depth/JE_input_Ref_depth), 
                      JE240404_Alt_LogFC = log2(JE240404_Alt_depth/JE_input_Alt_depth))


for(i in 1:nrow(wilcox_data)){
  ref <- c(wilcox_data$JE211101_Ref_LogFC[i], wilcox_data$JE211121_Ref_LogFC[i], wilcox_data$JE240314_Ref_LogFC[i], wilcox_data$JE240325_Ref_LogFC[i], wilcox_data$JE240404_Ref_LogFC[i])
  alt <- c(wilcox_data$JE211101_Alt_LogFC[i], wilcox_data$JE211121_Alt_LogFC[i], wilcox_data$JE240314_Alt_LogFC[i], wilcox_data$JE240325_Alt_LogFC[i], wilcox_data$JE240404_Alt_LogFC[i])
  tmp_test <- t.test(ref, alt, paired = TRUE)
  wilcox_data$pvalue[i] = tmp_test[["p.value"]]
  wilcox_data$diff[i] = tmp_test[["estimate"]]
  wilcox_data$Ref_LogFC_Ave[i] = mean(ref)
  wilcox_data$Alt_LogFC_Ave[i] = mean(alt)
}
wilcox_data$FDR = p.adjust(wilcox_data$pvalue)
table(wilcox_data$FDR<0.05)

write_xlsx(wilcox_data, "/gau/isilon/int/xzhang/Pacemaker/STARR_seq/Control_Regions_Included/T_test_alleles_Norm_By_SNP_Reads.xlsx")
```
